snippet.title: PULSARI — Official Release Trailer | Out now on Steam
snippet.description:
Buy PULSARI on Steam:
store.steampowered.com/app/4654150/PULSARI?utm_source=youtube

PULSARI is a precision rhythm arcade game where the music doesn’t begin until you earn it.

Strike beats from four directions to build each track layer by layer. Keep the combo alive, unlock the sound, and survive the pressure — because one miss can tear the music apart.

#PULSARI #rhythmgame  #steamgames
